name: Parles Wafers Tangy Tomato
ingredients_raw: POTATOES, REFINED OIL (@/$), SEASONING [SUGAR, IODISED SALT, SPICES & CONDIMENTS^ (CHILLI, CUMIN, CINNAMON), CLOVE, FENNEL, GINGER, LONG PEPPER, VEGETABLE POWDER (ONION, GARLIC), MALTODEXTRIN POWDER, TOMATO POWDER, HYDROLYSED VEGETABLE PROTEIN (SOY), YEAST EXTRACT, ACIDITY REGULATOR (262), NATURAL COLOUR (160c), FLAVOUR ENHANCER (627, 631) AND ANTICAKING AGENT]. CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOUR (S) - NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES. CONTAINS: SOY. *USED AS NATURAL FLAVORING AGENTS. ^LAST CHARACTER OF THE BATCH INDICATES NAME OF THE OIL: @ - Refined Palmolein Oil, $ - Refined Cotton Seed Oil.
